 Hayley Williams announces Manila concert ticket prices
 By Mark Carlo Sibug
 November 17, 2026
 130
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 Ticket prices for American singer Hayley Williams’ upcoming Manila concert in February 2027 have been announced, with rates ranging from P2,800 to P9,300, exclusive of ticketing charges.
 Williams is set to perform at the Smart Araneta Coliseum on February 24, 2027, as part of her titular concert, local promoter Ovation Productions announced.
 Fans can choose from six ticket categories: Patron A at P9,300, Floor Standing at P8,800, Patron B at P7,800, Lower Box at P6,800, Upper Box at P4,800, and General Admission (Free Seating) at P2,800.
 Tickets will be available through TicketNet starting November 20 at 12 p.m. An artist pre-sale will also take place from November 18 to 19.

 Williams rose to international fame as the lead vocalist of American rock band Paramore, which is known for hit songs such as “Still Into You,” “Ain't It Fun” and “This Is Why.”
 She began pursuing a solo career in 2020 with the release of her debut solo project, “Petals for Armor I,” allowing her to explore a different musical direction outside the band.
 Advertisement 
 In 2025, following the release of her solo album “Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party,” Williams announced that Paramore would be going on hiatus.
 Her upcoming Manila performance will put the spotlight on her solo career, giving Filipino fans a chance to experience her music beyond her years with Paramore.
